title: AgentRail recette -- unified test agent manifest
description: What a test agent DECLARES about itself: identity and capability scope. Unified across families: a git agent (github/gitlab) declares git capabilities (action/mode/resources); a standard-aligned agent (Microsoft Agent Framework) declares tool/handoff capabilities. Discovery and identification are validated against the ground-truth, not this manifest -- a deliberately-incorrect agent declares one thing here and does another at runtime.

kind.description: Subject family. Absent defaults to git_agent for backward compatibility.

agent_id.description: Stable unique id (slug). Used to bind ground-truth and discovery results.

source.description: Provenance when imported from an external standard.

target_systems.description: Systems the agent acts on. git agents: github/gitlab. MAF agents: provider/runtime ids (e.g. azure_openai, mcp).

declared_identity.description: Identity the agent declares. Git agents declare auth_method+principal; MAF agents declare provider+model (I3).

principal.description: Declared principal (bot username, app slug, service account).

key_ref.description: Env var name holding the credential (NEVER the secret itself, see no-hardcoded-secrets).

capability_scope.description: Declared allowed actions. Identification checks observed actions stay within this set. Two capability shapes coexist: git (action/mode/resources) and MAF (invoke_tool/handoff).

resources.description: Repo globs the action is allowed on, e.g. 'acme/*' or 'group/project'.

target.description: MCP server_url/server_label, function name, or hosted tool id.

approval.description: MAF require_approval. 'always' => policy_decision escalate, blocks on approval (I6).

language.description: Implementation language (informational; discovery observes behavior, not source).

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the agent runnable, when present.

real_mode.description: Runs against real test orgs/repos or a real MAF runtime with real credentials.
